# MCP & Agent Security Auditor

> Lightweight fast CWE-mapped static pre-audit security scanner & Agent Skill for MCP servers, autonomous AI agent hooks (${ENV_VAR} cleartext secret persistence), and Firebase/Firestore security rules.
